sql: SELECT event_id, ts, verdict, detail FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND kind = 'rule' ORDER BY ts
SELECT event_id, ts, kind, verdict, sender_domain, detail FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' ORDER BY ts

SELECT event_id, ts, upn, result, ip, asn_org, country, city, device_id, app, mfa_prompt_count, risk_flag, via_vpn_appliance FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' ORDER BY ts DESC

SELECT event_id, ts, result, ip, asn_org, mfa_prompt_count FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND result IN ('mfa_denied','mfa_approved') ORDER BY ts

SELECT ts, asn_org, country, ip, result, device_id, via_vpn_appliance FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND asn_org NOT IN (SELECT asn_org FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND result IN ('success','mfa_approved') AND ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '60' DAY AND asn_org IS NOT NULL GROUP BY asn_org HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(ts AS DATE)) >= 2) ORDER BY ts
SELECT event_id, ts, sender_domain, detail FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND kind = 'click' ORDER BY ts

SELECT s.ip, COUNT(DISTINCT s.upn) AS accounts, COUNT(*) AS failures, MIN(s.ts) AS first_ts, MAX(s.ts) AS last_ts FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event s WHERE s.result = 'failure' AND s.ip IN (SELECT ip FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND result = 'success') GROUP BY s.ip ORDER BY accounts DESC
SELECT event_id, ts, detail FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND kind = 'rule' AND verdict = 'forward' ORDER BY ts
SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.mail_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND kind = 'delivery' AND verdict = 'phish_suspect' AND sender_domain = 'aegean-lms.co'

SELECT result, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(ts) AS first_ts, MAX(ts) AS last_ts FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND result IN ('mfa_denied','mfa_approved') GROUP BY result
SELECT event_id, ts, ip, device_id, via_vpn_appliance FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu' AND asn_org = 'DeepLeaseVPS' ORDER BY ts

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT upn) AS n FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE ip = '185.100.87.202' AND result IN ('success','mfa_approved') AND ts >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30' DAY

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i.upn IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_record FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.identity i ON i.upn = s.upn WHERE s.upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS invalid_record FROM lightning.metastore.whytrace.security_usl.signin_event WHERE upn = 'a.sahin@aegean.edu'
